summary.text: Kevin West is a Republican who represents Oklahoma House District 54, serving since the 56th Legislature. In the 60th Legislature he is an oversight committee chair, and he was an Assistant Majority Floor Leader in the 59th.

paragraphs.text: West was born in Oklahoma City, was raised in South Oklahoma City, and graduated from Douglass High School.
On an academic scholarship to Northeastern Oklahoma A & M he studied construction and business, then spent several years working in cabinet shops before opening his own shop in Oklahoma City.
West has been married to his high-school sweetheart for over 35 years, and they have two adult children and four grandchildren.
He and his wife are active members of Regency Park Baptist Church in Moore and have volunteered with the Oklahoma Baptist Disaster Relief Team.
